Given that the failure is due to a lack of proper handling of the `Int64` type in the `StringArray.astype` method, the best locations to fix would be within the `astype` method itself. Specifically, ensuring that the method correctly handles the conversion to `Int64` when the input data contains string representations of integers and `pd.NA`.
